# Roadmap: DevOps Engineer

## Role overview

Automates building, testing and deploying software.

## Prerequisites

- None. Start with Stage 1.
- Usually 1+ years of experience when hired

## Learning stages

### Stage 1: Core skills

- [ ] [DevOps](../topics/devops.md)

## Also needed

Bash, Python, YAML, Groovy, HCL, Terraform, Ansible, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Argo CD, Helm, SonarQube

## Where it leads

Grow: Platform Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer (SRE), Cloud Architect · Lead: Engineering Manager · Pivot: AI Infrastructure / LLMOps Engineer, MLOps Engineer, Application Security (AppSec) / DevSecOps Engineer, Cloud Security Engineer
